transforms.name: Domain → DNS records
transforms.description: Resolve A, AAAA, MX, NS and TXT records of a domain (dnspython, or DNS-over-HTTPS fallback).

transforms.name: Domain → Certificate Transparency
transforms.description: Find subdomains and TLS certificates for a domain in crt.sh Certificate Transparency logs.

transforms.name: IP → RDAP / ASN
transforms.description: Look up the registered network owner (RDAP) of a public IP address; network range, CIDRs and origin ASN are added as properties of the IP.

transforms.name: URL → HTTP headers
transforms.description: Fetch HTTP response headers of a URL: server banner, security headers and redirect chain.

transforms.name: Web search
transforms.description: Search the web for a free-text query (the value) and return result URLs with titles and snippets, grouped into branches (site pages, apps, social & video, other sites). Falls back to DuckDuckGo Instant Answer + Wikipedia when full web results are unavailable.

transforms.name: News search
transforms.description: Find news articles about a free-text query (the value), with outlet and publish date, grouped under a News branch. Run it on the News branch to add more articles.

transforms.name: URL → page text
transforms.description: Download a web page and return its title, description, readable text, outbound links and any analytics/ad tracking codes (Google Analytics, GTM, AdSense) as properties.

transforms.name: IP → open ports & vulns (InternetDB)
transforms.description: Open ports, software (CPE), known vulnerabilities (CVEs) and hostnames of a public IP from Shodan InternetDB's scan data. Does not contact the target.

transforms.name: Username → accounts
transforms.description: Check ~700 websites for accounts with this username (WhatsMyName site list) and return the profiles found. Takes about a minute; hits are leads to verify.
